business_problem: As a global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, Carrier Global Corporation (Carrier) strives to advance sustainable, efficient building environments and help customers reduce their carbon footprints.
solution_summary: As a global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, Carrier Global Corporation (Carrier) strives to advance sustainable, efficient building environments and help customers reduce their carbon footprints. One of its products, Abound Net Zero Management, is designed to optimize energy efficiency and sustainability in buildings. Carrier wanted to scale this product for a global audience, especially in regard to managing and interpreting diverse utility data across different regions and languages. Carrier Uses Amazon Bedrock to Help Customers Achieve Their Sustainability Goals The implementation relies on Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Textract, Amazon S3, Amazon SageMaker to ingest, process, store, and serve the workload at scale while reducing operational overhead.

solution_components.name: Amazon Bedrock
solution_components.role: Runs the foundation model layer for the document ingestion and extraction workflows.

solution_components.name: Amazon Textract
solution_components.role: Extracts structured data from documents used by the document ingestion and extraction workflows.

solution_components.name: Amazon S3
solution_components.role: Stores source data, documents, or generated artifacts used by the document ingestion and extraction workflows.

solution_components.name: Amazon SageMaker
solution_components.role: Builds, trains, or deploys the machine learning models behind the document ingestion and extraction workflows.
